texts.myproject/1-GST225-aging/run_10-12ns/ext:
# GST-225 8001 原子老化续跑: 从 10.006 ns 末态 (step 5003000, 含速度) 再跑 2 ns 到 12.006 ns
# 势函数、时间步长、控温与 run_10ns/2_lammps_MQ.in 的老化段相同
units         metal
atom_style    atomic
atom_modify   map yes
newton        on
read_data     a-GST-10ns.data
reset_timestep 5003000
pair_style    mliap unified /scratch/t0937929/myproject/1-GST225-aging/01-model/GST225_Aging_Model.model-mliap_lammps.pt 0
pair_coeff    * * Ge Sb Te
compute       pe_atom all pe/atom
timestep      0.002
thermo_style  custom step pe ke etotal temp press vol
thermo        100
fix           relax all nvt temp 373 373 0.2
# 起点校验: 原跑 MQ.log 在 step 5003000 的 PE = -29066.304 eV, 差 > 0.5 eV (0.06 meV/atom) 则中止
run           0
variable      pe0 equal pe
print         "CHECK start PE = ${pe0} eV (original run: -29066.304)"
if "$(abs(v_pe0+29066.304)) > 0.5" then "print 'ABORT start PE mismatch'" "quit 1"
restart       250000 aging.restartA aging.restartB   # 每 0.5 ns 交替写断点
# 每 10 ps 一帧, 共 200 帧 (~75 MB), 列与原 dump 相同, 供后续做 IS
dump          D all custom 5000 GST_aging_10-12ns.dump id type x y z ix iy iz c_pe_atom
dump_modify   D sort id
run           1000000
undump        D
unfix         relax
write_data    a-GST-12ns.data
